description: Automerge preset: only for repositories listed in automerge.enabled_repositories of the Policy_File. Extend it AFTER supply-chain.json. Rule order matters: the exclusions come last.

packageRules.description: Automerge first-party GitHub Actions patch updates only. A github-tags update is aged by the commit date, which a force-pushed tag does not reset, so third-party Actions stop at a pull request
Hub reusable workflows are never automerged (placed after the allow rules so it overrides them)
Never automerge vulnerability fixes (placed after the allow rules; vulnerabilityAlerts.automerge=false in supply-chain.json is the primary control)
